content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Apologies if this isn't the right section for my question. I have a [product_name] and a [product_name] operator panel which show incorrect time, because the operator panel cannot synchronize time using the [product_name] communication protocol. Is there a solution to keep both devices showing the same time?

Hi [user_name], Starting from [product_name] [version_no], communication with an NTP server is supported. If you have this version or newer, using Network Time Protocol is recommended to synchronize time (applies to [product_name] [version_no] and later only).
